title: 印度市场高频交易崛起 散户与算法博弈加剧
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Today, financial markets operate faster than at any point in human history.
segments.zh: 如今，金融市场的运行速度比人类历史上任何时候都快。

segments.en: Speed naturally across any field, wherever you are quick and fast, you will dominate.
segments.zh: 速度在任何领域都是天然优势，谁快谁就能主导。

segments.en: Talkmark is an all different for that. Servers now sit on site for trades that occur at a billionth of a second via fiber optics.
segments.zh: Talkmark 在这方面与众不同。服务器现在就在交易现场，通过光纤以十亿分之一秒的速度完成交易。

segments.en: Microwaves being data through the air to cut fiber lag.
segments.zh: 微波通过空气传输数据，以减少光纤延迟。

segments.en: Bots are fast replacing human traders.
segments.zh: 机器人正在快速取代人类交易员。

segments.en: Something like 75% of the trading is automated.
segments.zh: 大约75%的交易是自动化的。

segments.en: You merit that the automated trading firms dominate.
segments.zh: 你注意到自动化交易公司占据主导地位。

segments.en: But this speed doesn't just make markets fast, it fundamentally changes the game.
segments.zh: 但这种速度不仅让市场变快，还从根本上改变了游戏规则。

segments.en: Complex algorithms put your everyday non-professional trader at a massive disadvantage in several ways.
segments.zh: 复杂的算法让日常的非专业交易者在多个方面处于巨大劣势。

segments.en: From an understanding point of view at a disadvantage, a technology point of view is at a disadvantage from a capital point of view is at a disadvantage.
segments.zh: 从理解角度处于劣势，从技术角度处于劣势，从资本角度也处于劣势。

segments.en: No market felt this disadvantage more intensely than India.
segments.zh: 没有哪个市场比印度更强烈地感受到这一劣势。

segments.en: In the last few years, a frenzy among non-professional investors, fueled by new mobile apps and influencers, led to losses of more than $33 billion in just four years through March 2025.
segments.zh: 过去几年，新移动应用和网红推动非专业市场参与者狂热，截至2025年3月的四年内损失超过330亿美元。

segments.en: More often than not, global high speed trading firms were on the other side of the trade.
segments.zh: 全球高速交易公司往往站在交易的另一边。
